description: This file defines the LoanReAgingValidator class which contains validation logic for re-aging and undo re-aging operations on loans within the Fineract project. It checks business rules such as loan status, schedule type, interest bearing status, and existing transactions to ensure re-aging requests are valid.

classes.name: LoanReAgingValidator
classes.description: A component responsible for validating re-aging and undo re-aging operations on loans, ensuring adherence to business rules.

methods.name: validateReAge
methods.description: Performs validation checks for re-aging a loan, including request validation, business rules, and outstanding balance.

methods.name: validateReAgeRequest
methods.description: Validates the parameters provided for re-aging a loan, such as dates, frequency, and installments.

methods.name: validateReAgeBusinessRules
methods.description: Checks business rules related to the loan’s status, schedule type, interest, and existing transactions before re-aging.

methods.name: validateReAgeOutstandingBalance
methods.description: Ensures the loan has outstanding balance and the re-aging date is appropriate.

methods.name: validateUndoReAge
methods.description: Validates the conditions for undoing a re-aging operation on a loan.

methods.name: validateUndoReAgeBusinessRules
methods.description: Checks if a re-aging transaction exists and no repayments occurred after re-aging before allowing undo.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationErrorsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are validation errors collected.

methods.name: transactionHappenedAfterOther
methods.description: Determines if a transaction occurred after another transaction based on change operations.
